task.source: https://github.com/voku/portable-ascii/issues/135 plus the failing test merged as https://github.com/voku/portable-ascii/pull/134
task.title: Inconsistence between `to_ascii` calls (since 2.10.0)

experiment_task.title: Make ASCII::to_ascii repeated calls consistent
experiment_task.text: Change voku\helper\ASCII::to_ascii so cold and warm calls for the supplied degree-sign/accented input consistently return the accepted `Webinaire des transitions n34 - Agir et mobiliser pour la biodiversite dans son entreprise` result. Update the existing regression expectation/name if needed. Preserve the public API and unrelated transliteration behavior.

edit_ranges.note: ASCII::to_ascii - both production fix hunks (base lines 828 and 893) are inside this one method

verified.test_note: the reproduction test already exists at the base commit (testToAsciiLongCorrectAcrossRepeatedCalls)

acceptance_assertions: The repeated-call regression passes with the accepted n34 output on both cold and warm calls.
The production change initializes ASCII maps before both language-map existence decisions in ASCII::to_ascii.
No files outside the two allowed paths differ from the post-setup baseline.

grading_note: The production fix inserts self::prepareAsciiMaps() before two use_transliterate decisions inside ASCII::to_ascii. The historical patch also replaces the pre-existing regression expectation/name in tests/AsciiTest.php.
